title: Corteva -24%, Nebius -17%, Cerebras +16%: 5 Movers #shorts
description: Corteva fell 24% Thursday after cutting its forecast on weak Brazil demand. Nebius, Super Micro and Strategy also fell, while Cerebras is up premarket Friday after raising its forecast.

beats.say: Which stock fell hardest on Thursday? Corteva, down twenty four percent, after cutting its forecast. Here are five big movers, ranked by size.
Number five. Strategy fell six and a half percent on Thursday, after MSCI said it plans to remove the stock from an index.

visual.reason: MSCI plans to remove it from an index

beats.say: Number four. Super Micro fell eleven percent on Thursday, after a report that U.S. officials are probing server smuggling.
Number three. Cerebras is up sixteen percent premarket on Friday, after raising its revenue forecast.
Number two. Nebius fell nearly seventeen percent on Thursday, after reporting results and pushing its seven billion dollar sales goal back to February.

visual.reason: Pushed $7B sales goal back to Feb.

beats.say: And number one. Corteva fell twenty four percent on Thursday, after cutting its forecast on weak demand in Brazil.

visual.reason: Cut forecast on weak Brazil demand
